limitations: Auth, account data, provider responses, persistence endpoints and render responses are simulated; no live generation, billing or production database writes are verified.
Real application UI, browser storage and client adapters execute. Browser reopen/reload is exercised; work continuing while the browser remains closed is not proven.
Seeded checkpoints prove restoration only, not the upstream generation that produced them. Request counts do not prove live billing, database concurrency or media quality.

flows.label: Draft and uploaded asset recovery
flows.test: typed brief and uploaded asset survive closing and reopening the page
flows.seeded: Fresh simulated signed-in account; local product photo.
flows.exercised: Type brief, upload, persist draft, close page, reopen, Resume; saved fields and image remain.

flows.label: Interrupted default-engine plan
flows.test: actual interrupted generation retains its persisted script in consumer review
flows.seeded: Fresh simulated account and generation responses; image request held pending.
flows.exercised: Make My Ad through persisted script, close actual page, reopen, Resume into consumer review; no automatic generation restart.

flows.label: Saved plan from Dashboard
flows.test: seeded completed plan opens from the real Dashboard with saved script and scenes
flows.seeded: Completed Testimonial session including script, character, scene image and thumbnail in IndexedDB.
flows.exercised: Reload Dashboard, Open ad plan; saved script and images load in consumer review without generation.

flows.label: Storyboard approval gate
flows.test: seeded storyboard gate remains parked after reload
flows.seeded: Producer run at Storyboard review with upstream artifacts and scene image.
flows.exercised: Open and reload saved run; Storyboard remains parked without submissions, final-render starts or checkpoints.

flows.label: First Cut approval gate
flows.test: seeded first_cut gate remains parked after reload
flows.seeded: Producer run at First Cut review including local fixture video.
flows.exercised: Open and reload saved run; First Cut video is playable and gate remains parked without new work.

flows.label: Recorded job resumes polling
flows.test: a real recorded job survives reload and polls the same handle without resubmitting
flows.seeded: Producer video-stage run; other stage artifacts already present; simulated job and final render.
flows.exercised: Real adapters submit, record handle, reload, poll same handle, complete scene and reach First Cut without resubmission.

flows.label: Saved-run load error and Retry
flows.test: seeded saved-run load failure offers Retry on the same run and Back
flows.seeded: Saved Producer Storyboard run; run fetch initially returns simulated 503.
flows.exercised: Saved error shows Retry and Back; Back/reopen preserves run ID; Retry loads same run without submissions or checkpoints.

flows.label: Final-render polling error and Retry
flows.test: seeded final-render polling failure exposes Retry and preserves completed scenes
flows.seeded: Producer final-render checkpoint with completed scene video; final polling initially returns simulated 503.
flows.exercised: Poll failure shows Retry without automatically restarting the final render; only customer Retry submits a new final render and retains completed scenes and run ID.

flows.label: Malformed saved-run response and Retry
flows.test: seeded malformed saved-run responses preserve Retry and the selected run
flows.seeded: Saved Producer run with malformed successful response variants; original valid checkpoint retained in the fixture.
flows.exercised: Malformed saved data offers Retry and Back, retains the selected run ID and submits no production; Retry after response repair restores the valid Storyboard gate.

flows.label: Missing saved run
flows.test: missing seeded run clears the stale reference and returns to launch
flows.seeded: Local active-run reference with simulated missing backend row (404).
flows.exercised: Open One-Shot; stale run reference clears, launch form returns, no submissions or checkpoints occur.
